randomness: Python random.Random; sort integer image IDs before sample; independent Random(seed) for A, train selection, validation selection and test fact sample; noise uses separate Random(seed+1) for train and Random(seed+2) for validation

A.components: vl_dedup_lr_K5_components.npy; record_id ascending, distinct from corpus feature row order
A.membership: sample unique image IDs; include every global component touched by any caption of selected images, then all members of those components
A.reuse: COCO_SCALE_RUN Stage A-D and CLIPScore; do not rerun
A.stage_E: score all expanded records including singleton records; judge all unordered pairs in each complete component with frozen STAGE_E_CLUSTERS_RUN visual-first Qwen2.5-VL-7B, context none
A.stage_F: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN export and RETAINED_AUDIT_RUN export_cluster policy b; representative max CLIPScore then min record_id; keep_augment closure, pending mismatch, remaining deleted
A.fusion_reference: MISMATCH_SCORES_RUN validation 6132 records; fixed CLIP and valid-Pyes midrank percentile references; mean percentile
A.coverage_unit: one sampled image per auditor request; list every deleted caption separately and the final retained captions in its complete component; ask supported/unsupported/uncertain coverage label per deleted record, allowing joint retained-caption coverage
A.coverage_denominator: deleted records belonging to the 500 sampled images only; expanded other-image records are context, reported separately
A.coverage_aggregation: strict: both auditors supported; loose: either supported; uncertain/missing never supported; report counts and total deleted denominator
A.distribution: sampled images by retained record count, explicitly including 0 and >5 if present; pending reported separately
A.budget: derive actual N and sum choose(component size,2); first 32 pairs and 32 records estimate remaining compute, including model load; stop if Stage E projected GPU time exceeds 21600 seconds

B.split_source: https://cs.stanford.edu/people/karpathy/deepimagesent/caption_datasets.zip :: dataset_coco.json; original or verbatim public mirror only; never synthesize

split_gate.failure: stop and report; preserve downloaded source

B.exclusions: project all COCO_SCALE_RUN source_inventory coco2017 source IDs to integer COCO image IDs; exclude from train pool; validation sampled from eligible val IDs; preserve full Karpathy test
B.leakage: before noise, require train versus validation/test and validation versus test disjoint image IDs and pHash Hamming <=2; use image content, independent of 2014/2017 split names; zero overlapping pairs required, do not replace sampled images on failure
B.image_mapping: COCO image ID, not native COCO2017 split; original 2017 ZIP can supply image bytes by ID where COCO_SCALE_RUN cache excludes an image

noise.copy_count: uniform integer 1..3 for each sampled original image
noise.edit_assignment: shuffle copy slots, half Mild and half Strong, odd slot assigned by seeded choice
noise.edit_source: EDIT_STRESS_RUN build_edit_stress.parameters and transform, via baselines_surfaces S2/S4 assets
noise.explicit_edit_interpretation: Mild=S2, Strong=S4; baselines_surfaces contains S2/S4 rather than named Mild/Strong. This mapping is an explicit implementation assumption, not a claim about existing label names
noise.Mild: center crop 12% per dimension; JPEG70; brightness seeded choice .92/1.08
noise.Strong: center crop35%; rotation6deg expanded gray canvas; JPEG70; channel factors uniform .95..1.05; EDIT_STRESS_RUN EDIT COPY watermark; flipped=false
noise.ncr: sample original image IDs independently of copy membership; seeded shuffled cycle of selected IDs assigns each donor caption bundle to next recipient, with no fixed points; copies inherit recipient's resulting caption bundle
noise.apply_to: train and validation independently; test clean

arms.VL_Dedup: complete Stage A-F on train only; retained only, held/pending excluded
arms.Clean: original selected 5000 train images and all original captions

dedup.scorer: CLASSIFIER_RUN vl_dedup_lr.joblib, 11-feature adapter including SSCD, excluding same_image_asset
dedup.candidate_search: global within each train or validation pool separately; no test candidates
dedup.K_selection: maximum exact pairwise graph F1 on noisy validation, visual_group=original_image_id; ties smaller K; no test read
dedup.record_score: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN validation-anchored fusion using frozen original MISMATCH_SCORES_RUN empirical references
dedup.t_selection: strict score < t; maximize exact mismatch F1 against known swapped-caption provenance on noisy validation; candidates observed validation score values and nextafter(value,+inf), plus 0 and 1; ties smaller t; freeze before train export/test evaluation
dedup.export: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN policy b with selected t; same CLIP representative and keep_augment closure
dedup.graph_gate: train complete component pairwise F1 using original_image_id >=0.9; report deleted swapped-caption count; stop without parameter revision below gate

model.initialization: GPT-2 language pretraining only, no COCO-trained caption checkpoint
model.schedule: linear warmup5000 steps then linear decay; cap warmup at total steps
model.selection: one fixed official-default-like hyperparameter configuration on Clean; no test-guided tuning
model.equal_steps: S=10*floor(N_clean/40), cycle shuffled training records to S optimizer steps for every arm
model.equal_epochs: also evaluate each arm checkpoint at10*floor(N_arm/40); continue to max(equal-step,equal-epoch target) in one trajectory; disclose exposure and schedule
model.decoding: deterministic greedy, maximum40 tokens, stop at EOS or first period; same for all arms

evaluation.chair: original LisaAnne/Hallucination utils/chair.py, original COCO2014 captions/instances annotations; no substitute labels
evaluation.clean_gate: Clean test CIDEr in [0.55,1.65], predeclared factor-of-two/50%-above interpretation of approximately1.1; outside stops, no test-driven tuning; full-data public ClipCap result is only reference, not an asserted 5k expectation
evaluation.fact_sample: 500 sorted-test-ID sampled images seed20261102; reference fact union from all five raw reference captions
evaluation.fact_unit: per image and auditor, request reference atomic facts plus coverage boolean per fact for all three generated captions in one request; strict/loose counts require exact fact alignment; unknown facts reported separately
evaluation.api_budget_includes: every attempt, including retries; both auditors; all evaluated conditions sharing one image request

B.timing_gate: first32 Stage E pairs/records and first100 training optimizer steps; measure model load and project each complete stage/job; stop if Stage E or one full training trajectory exceeds21600 GPU seconds; estimates are not measurements of completed runs

inference.record_prompt:
Caption: {caption}
Does this caption correctly describe the image? Answer with yes or no.
inference.engine: vLLM 0.11.0, float16, eager, seed0, max_model_len8192, max_num_batched_tokens4096, max_num_seqs16, batch16
inference.invalid: preserve raw and terminal status; Pyes invalid effective percentile1.0; never silently drop from denominators

audits.api_attempts: cap includes each actual request; save raw per attempt and counts; no new calls on exhausted cap
audits.uncertainty: AI strict/loose counts are aggregation rules, not human truth or confidence bounds

reporting.unrun: null with reason, never zero performance
reporting.timing: GPU model, wall clock, lock wait, actual compute vs projection, API requests separately
reporting.historical_hash_fields: N/A: no new file hashes by explicit user instruction
reporting.stop: preserve failures and completed partial outputs; report exact failed gate without retuning
